about: Patterns that must not appear anywhere in data/, the store or the built site. publish/build.py and publish/export.py fail on one hit. Generic shapes only: a value that identifies a person or a machine never goes in this file, because this file is public. The export also applies the research repository's own leak rules, which stay private.

patterns.why: a local Windows home path, with either slash
a scratch path of the research repository
the named ISP of a probe machine
a Tailscale ping line naming a device
a device name in a probe URL
terms text; the published corpus is technical only
a personal email address: a provider's own address is on its own domain
